verified_key_information_units.information: Consolidated revenue increased by 11% to EUR 338.3 million in 2024, driven by net interest income growth of 8% to EUR 273.3 million and net fee and commission income growth of 24% to EUR 60.3 million; net profit rose 7% to EUR 150.3 million, resulting in a cost-to-income ratio of 43.4% and return on equity of 24.5%.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Summary of the year 2024 (pages 10-11); Consolidated statement of profit or loss (page 189)

candidate_sentences.text: LHV Group reported a record net profit of EUR 150.3 million for 2024, up 7% from EUR 140.9 million in 2023.
Pre-tax profit increased to EUR 175.1 million, while net income rose 11% to EUR 338.3 million.
Net interest income grew 8% to EUR 273.3 million and net fee and commission income increased 24% to EUR 60.3 million.
The cost-to-income ratio increased slightly to 43.4% from 42.3%, while return on equity declined to 24.5% from 29.0% and net interest margin fell to 3.48% from 3.88%.

verified_key_information_units.information: The loan portfolio expanded by EUR 990 million (28% YoY) to EUR 4.6 billion, comprising Estonian corporate loans up 21% to EUR 2.3 billion, Estonian retail loans up 21% to EUR 1.9 billion, and UK SME loans up 338% to EUR 0.3 billion.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Summary of the year 2024 (page 10); Note 12, Loans and advances to customers (page 223)

candidate_sentences.text: Total assets reached EUR 8.7 billion, up 23%, the net loan portfolio increased EUR 990 million, or 28%, to EUR 4.6 billion, and deposits rose 21% to EUR 6.9 billion.
Corporate lending in Estonia grew 21% to EUR 2.3 billion, Estonian retail loans rose 21% to EUR 1.9 billion, and UK SME lending expanded 338% to EUR 348 million.

verified_key_information_units.information: Deposits grew by EUR 1,179 million (21% YoY) to EUR 6.9 billion, with regular customer deposits in LHV Pank rising EUR 554 million (14% YoY to EUR 4.6 billion) and deposits from financial intermediaries increasing significantly (LHV Bank collections up EUR 416 million, +388% YoY), partly offset by LHV Pank reducing platform deposits by one-third.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Summary of the year 2024 (page 10); Note 17, Deposits from customers (page 226)

verified_key_information_units.information: Assets under management increased to EUR 1.56 billion (3% YoY), primarily due to positive market returns, with LHV Varahaldus maintaining a ~25% market share in Estonia's II pillar pension system managing savings for 22.3% of participants.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Summary of the year 2024 (page 10); Overview of LHV Varahaldus (page 24)

candidate_sentences.text: Varahaldus’ profit edged down to EUR 1.6 million, while assets under management rose 3%; no success fee was earned because cumulative fund performance remained below the benchmark.

verified_key_information_units.information: Customer base grew with LHV Pank reaching 456,000 clients (+9% YoY, including 38,000 new customers), and LHV Kindlustus insuring 170,000 customers (+6% YoY).

verified_key_information_units.information: Operations occurred amid a contracting Estonian economy (GDP -0.7% YoY) and stabilized UK economy, with LHV Pank maintaining tight credit quality (loans overdue >60 days at 0.3% of portfolio) and benefiting from rising corporate loan demand late in the year.

candidate_sentences.text: Management attributed the Group’s profit growth primarily to strong asset growth, cost management and sustained credit quality.
However, the share of loans in Stage 2 and Stage 3 increased, and the Group raised impairment allowances as Estonia’s recession continued, although non-performing loans remained at a low level.
The operating environment became less supportive during the year.
LHV stated that falling rates and the repricing cost of deposits negatively affected LHV Pank’s results, while intense competition in both lending and deposits further pressured margins.

K7 is MISSING as dividend proposal details are absent. The summary captures most high-importance financial results and some medium items, but key omissions (especially in K3, K5, K6, K7) prevent a 'Yes' rating.

coherence_issues.description: S1 states a record net profit of EUR 150.3 million for 2024, while S2 states net income rose 11% to EUR 338.3 million. These are different metrics (net profit vs. net income) but the summary does not clarify this distinction, potentially confusing the reader about which figure represents the Group's primary profitability measure.

LHV Group reported a record net profit of EUR 150.3 million for 2024, up 7% from EUR 140.9 million in 2023.

details.coherence_justification: The summary is generally coherent with a logical flow from overall performance to segment results and outlook. However, there is a potential confusion between 'net profit' (S1) and 'net income' (S2) without clarification that these are distinct metrics. The rest of the summary maintains clear relationships between causes and effects (e.g., asset growth driving profit, margin pressures from rate changes) and organizes information logically from group performance to divisions. There are no severe contradictions, and repetition is minimal. The self-contradiction issue is limited to metric terminology ambiguity rather than a fundamental logical flaw.
